subcategory_text: Provide training so that each member of the software development team has the skills and knowledge needed to fulfil their responsibilities.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: AT-2, AT-3, SA-16
implementation_examples: Provide hands-on training mapped to each security role
Maintain role-based learning paths and certification records
Offer mentoring and pairing for newly assigned security responsibilities
assessment_objectives: Determine whether role-specific training is provided to each software development team member.
Determine whether training effectiveness is evaluated.
